new_destinations.name: Yandang Mountains
new_destinations.name_evidence: Wikivoyage Wenzhou lists 'Yandang Mountains' as a headline See entry with the sub-areas Lingfeng, Lingyan, Dalongchu and Sanzhe; English Wikipedia article 'Yandang Mountains' (national scenic area, ~6,000 views/yr).
new_destinations.reason: Named headline scenic area with four kept sub-area spots; ranked 3 (regional favourite, not a national top-tier draw).

review.name: Jiangxin Temple
review.case_for: Wikivoyage lists the temple (free) with old and new pagodas on Jiangxin Island (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Part of the Jiangxin Island spot (rule 3) and its link is dead; kept island alone covers the visit.

review.name: Taiping Temple
review.case_for: Wikivoyage See listing: temple founded 942, rebuilt 2003-06, free (rule 1).
review.case_against: Wikivoyage itself calls it "really new"; a rebuilt local temple, short visit, one source.

review.name: Epoch Art Museum
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou See listing: contemporary art museum in Bailuzhou Park, Y30 (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Single source, listing dated 2019, local contemporary art; opening status unverified.

review.name: Wenzhou Revolutionary History Memorial Museum
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou See listing: free revolutionary-history museum on Jiangxin Island (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Memorial-hall museum of local interest, dead link, adjacent to the island spot.

review.name: Wutian Old Street
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou See listing: grey-brick traditional architecture beside the Tanghe River, evening strolls (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Single source, partly rebuilt/commercial, only listed with a night bus; short visit.

review.name: Jingshan Park
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou See listing: large forest park with views over Wenzhou, Y30 (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Local park whose main draw is the zoo inside; dead link.

review.name: Jiushan Park
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou See listing: small lake park with a tall pagoda to climb for city views, free (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Small local park, pagoda access hours listed as 8-11 and 1-2.

review.name: Sanyang Wetlands
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou See listing: 136 islands linked by bridges, metro S1 (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Dead link; Wikivoyage says the attraction was still being built, so what a visitor can do is unclear.

review.name: Wenzhou Zoo
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou See listing: city zoo with penguins and lions, Y30 (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Ordinary city zoo, one source, dead link; friend test fails.

review.name: Wenzhou Amusement Park
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou See listing Do: permanent ride park, Y130 (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Local theme park 30 km out; not a reason to travel; one source.

review.name: Puzhuang Fortress
review.case_for: China Daily (Zhejiang) features the 630-year-old Puzhuangsuo fortress, a national relic in Cangnan; no Wikivoyage or guidebook entry found (rule 1).
review.case_against: Only a news feature, not a visitor listing.

review.name: Longwan Fort
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou names the "historic Yongchang Fort" in Longwan (likely this place) (rule 1).
review.case_against: Name match uncertain, one passing mention, access unverified.

review.name: Middle Yandang Mountains
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Wenzhou district blurb: Zhong Yandang scenic area is "perfect for hiking" (rule 1).
review.case_against: Separate range section from North Yandang but one passing mention; may be part of Yandang spot.

review.name: Yan Lake
review.case_for: Official Yandangshan site lists Yanhu (Wild Goose Lake) as one of its eight zones; Wikivoyage ticketed listing (rule 1).
review.case_against: A lake zone with less to do than the Three Wonders; part of the larger Yandang spot.

review.name: Fang Cave
review.case_for: Wikivoyage ticketed listing; Trip.com guide mentions the Fangdong zone with a cable car in the core Yandang route (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Part of Yandang; the official site names a different cave (Yangjiaodong) among its zones.

review.name: Twelve Peaks
review.case_for: Wikivoyage ticketed listing; web search found it in itineraries without description (rule 1).
review.case_against: Part of Nanxi River; no detail found on what a visitor does.

review.name: Daitou Ancient Village
review.case_for: Wikivoyage ticketed listing; web search found it only in lists with Furong and Cangpo, no detail (rule 1).
review.case_against: Little independent description; overlaps two stronger villages.

review.name: Shiwei Rock
review.case_for: Wikivoyage ticketed listing; Trip.com guide describes a mast-shaped Danxia rock for hiking and rafting (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: A feature of Nanxi River scenic area, one visit among many.

review.name: Qingjie She Village
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Pingyang See: She ethnic village with song and dance performances (rule 1).
review.case_against: Experience is performance-based and may not run daily (rule 4); one source.

review.name: Pingyang County Museum
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Pingyang See listing, Tue-Sun (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Local county museum, no description of exhibits, one source.

review.name: Fenghu Theme Park
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Pingyang See: free lakeside park for walking and sunsets (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Local urban park; no distinct draw.

review.name: Su Buqing's Former Residence
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Pingyang See: house of the famed mathematician (rule 1).
review.case_against: Public access and exhibits unclear; one source, short visit.

review.name: Mount Akaiwa
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Pingyang Do: "roof of Pingyang" climb for experienced walkers (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Rarely visited, one source, no trail details.

review.name: Taishun Radon Spring
review.case_for: A Taishun attractions list names the Radon Spring Scenic Area beside Wuyanling and Langqiao Cultural Park; hot-spring venue judged on merits (rule 1, 2).
review.case_against: Only a list mention; exact site match uncertain.

review.name: Banping Mountain
review.case_for: Wikivoyage Dongtou blurb; Trip.com describes a sea cliff on the east of the area, best seen from Wanghai Tower (rule 1).
review.case_against: Mostly a view from the tower, so part of that stop.

notes: Wenzhou city, Dongtou and Nanxi River stay standalone: each has fewer than four kept places. If the review entries (8 Wenzhou city sites; Banping Mountain for Dongtou; Daitou, Shiwei Rock, Twelve Peaks for Nanxi) are approved, Wenzhou, Dongtou and Nanxi River would each reach the four-spot bar and should be re-placed as destinations.
Coordinates marked from Wikivoyage listing geo are the listing's own point; the pin stage should still run resolve-pin on every spot. Entries with coordinates null have pin_needed true.
Costs would be CNY; all draft fields left null with needs_research.
